name: sample-repo
description: Labeled retrieval questions for tests/fixtures/sample-repo. Each question lists the source ranges a correct answer must be grounded in. Kept outside the fixture directory so the labels are never indexed. 'dev' questions may be used while tuning retrieval; 'test' questions must not be.
